title: Dualizability detected by jointly conservative closed monoidal functors
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ and $(\mathcal D_i)_{i\in I}$ be symmetric monoidal categories: monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with a symmetry, that is, isomorphisms $\sigma_{A,B}:A\otimes B\xrightarrow{\sim}B\otimes A$ natural in both variables with $\sigma_{B,A}\circ\sigma_{A,B}=1$ and $\alpha_{B,C,A}\circ\sigma_{A,B\otimes C}\circ\alpha_{A,B,C}=(1_B\otimes\sigma_{A,C})\circ\alpha_{B,A,C}\circ(\sigma_{A,B}\otimes1_C)$, $\alpha$ the associator. Assume that each category has chosen internal-Hom objects $[A,B]$ and natural tensor--internal-Hom adjunction bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}(A\otimes B,C)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A,[B,C]),$$
whose value at a morphism is called its transpose. Let $F_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D_i$ be strong symmetric monoidal functors: strong monoidal functors [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor] whose tensorators $\mu_{A,B}:F_iA\otimes F_iB\xrightarrow{\sim}F_i(A\otimes B)$ satisfy $F_i(\sigma_{A,B})\circ\mu_{A,B}=\mu_{B,A}\circ\sigma_{F_iA,F_iB}$. Suppose the family is jointly conservative: a morphism $a$ of $\mathcal C$ is an isomorphism whenever every $F_i(a)$ is an isomorphism. For each $i$ assume a natural isomorphism $h_i(A,B):F_i([A,B])\xrightarrow{\sim}[F_iA,F_iB]$ such that the tensor--internal-Hom adjunctions are preserved: for every $g:A\otimes B\to C$, the transpose of $F_i(g)\circ\mu_{A,B}:F_iA\otimes F_iB\to F_iC$ is $h_i(B,C)\circ F_i(\tilde g)$, where $\tilde g:A\to[B,C]$ is the transpose of $g$. Then, for an object $K$ of $\mathcal C$, $K$ is dualizable (there are an object $D$, evaluation $D\otimes K\to\mathbf1$ and coevaluation $\mathbf1\to K\otimes D$ satisfying both triangle identities) if and only if every $F_i(K)$ is dualizable in $\mathcal D_i$. The index set $I$ may be empty or infinite.

proof.text: Identify the given internal-Hom comparison h_i(B,T) with the canonical mate Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison. Put A=[B,T] and apply the transpose hypothesis to g = symmetry(A,B) followed by evaluation B tensor A -> T. Expand F_i of a composite. The symmetry compatibility rewrites mu(A,B) followed by F_i(symmetry(A,B)); the two symmetries cancel in each category. The transpose of evaluation is the identity, so the resulting equation is curry(mu(B,A) followed by F_i(evaluation)) = h_i(B,T). The left side is exactly ihomComparison_app_eq_curry. Thus the canonical comparison is invertible at every T. The extra contravariant naturality hypothesis is retained but is not needed.

For each i, swap the assumed exact pairing for F_i K using BraidedCategory.exactPairing_swap to get a left dual. The proved source theorem isIso_ihomUnitTensorToIhom makes the target comparison invertible: its proof identifies tensor with internal Hom by the exact-pairing tensor adjunction and uniqueness of right adjoints. With the canonical internal-Hom comparison invertible by the previous step, Functor.Monoidal.isIso_map_ihomUnitTensorToIhom_of_ihomComparison makes F_i(t) invertible. This source theorem follows from its explicit tensorator/unit/evaluation comparison equation.

It constructs coevaluation as the transpose of the right unitor followed by the inverse of t, takes internal-Hom evaluation as evaluation, and proves both triangles by uncurrying and tensor interchange. This gives ExactPairing [K,1] K. Swap it through the braiding to get ExactPairing K [K,1], and supply this explicit internal dual as the existential witness. No new construction or unproved intermediate theorem is needed.

lean.statement: theorem dualizable_iff_of_jointly_conservative {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [MonoidalCategory C] [SymmetricCategory C] [MonoidalClosed C] {I : Type w} (D : I → Type u') [∀ i, Category.{v'} (D i)] [∀ i, MonoidalCategory (D i)] [∀ i, SymmetricCategory (D i)] [∀ i, MonoidalClosed (D i)] (F : ∀ i, C ⥤ D i) [∀ i, (F i).Monoidal] (hSymmetry : ∀ (i : I) (A B : C), Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (F i) A B ≫ (F i).map (β_ A B).hom = (β_ ((F i).obj A) ((F i).obj B)).hom ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (F i) B A) (hConservative : ∀ {A B : C} (a : A ⟶ B), (∀ i : I, IsIso ((F i).map a)) → IsIso a) (h : ∀ (i : I) (B : C), ihom B ⋙ F i ≅ F i ⋙ ihom ((F i).obj B)) (hHomNaturality : ∀ (i : I) {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) (T : C), (F i).map ((pre f).app T) ≫ (h i A).hom.app T = (h i B).hom.app T ≫ (pre ((F i).map f)).app ((F i).obj T)) (hTranspose : ∀ (i : I) (A B T : C) (g : A ⊗ B ⟶ T), curry ((β_ ((F i).obj B) ((F i).obj A)).hom ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (F i) A B ≫ (F i).map g) = (F i).map (curry ((β_ B A).hom ≫ g)) ≫ (h i B).hom.app T) (K : C) : (∃ E : C, Nonempty (ExactPairing K E)) ↔ ∀ i : I, ∃ E : D i, Nonempty (ExactPairing ((F i).obj K) E)
